description:
[Servers] Find a drawn map by seed + size, map-file URL, map key or server address. Returns the job view `{job_id, status, source, url, seed, size, requested_at, error, map}` where `map` is
the full map (as in `/servers/{id}/map`, with monuments) once drawn. A seed + size lookup also finds a map
drawn from a procedural server's own file. 404 when nothing is known yet - ask for it with `POST /maps`.
With `address` the answer is the server's view (as `/servers/{id}/map`). Look a map up by seed + size, by the .map URL, by job id, or by a server's ip:port. Not known yet? Ask for it with create_map (asynchronous).

address.description: A server address `ip:port` (game or query port).

key.description: A map key / job id (32 hex characters; the URL hash).

url.description: A .map file URL exactly as a server publishes it.

name: get_map
title: Find a drawn map by seed + size, map-file URL, map key or server address
